interrupted_native_probe.status: Interrupted after two alert-retention failures identified a pre-existing Windows filename terminator defect.
interrupted_native_probe.resolution: Explicit trailing UTF-16 NUL; deterministic baseline/current canary in rename-proof.json; final full regression below.

full_regression.failure_scope: One existing wall-clock fixture crossed a five-minute alert identity epoch; corrected in the test-only followup. Comprehensive containment and disposable self-test child hit their original deadlines; the same unchanged tests/sources passed in a fresh 13-case process. Exact cause of the transient backlog/startup latency is unproven.

source_freeze.scope: All Python source under src, tests and tools, UTF-8 text with normalized newlines. Identical before and after the complete run, before the documented clock-fixture and entrypoint followups.
source_freeze.post_run_application_scope: Six Python entrypoint/control files and one existing test file; exact paths/hashes and real-repository focused gate in entrypoint-followup.json. Two native Go launchers and two Go test files have separate compile/execution proof there.

test_only_followup.scope: Module-local fixed wall clock in the retention/dedup budget fixture; real file custody and all budget assertions preserved. Independent epoch/TTL behavior remains tested.

unchanged_source_timeout_followup.scope: Comprehensive inert containment plus all 12 sandbox resource cases, in one fresh process before any source correction. Original 100-second response and 10-second sandbox deadlines retained.
unchanged_source_timeout_followup.causal_limit: A passing repeat does not establish the physical cause of the earlier backlog or child startup delay.
